batch: OLP-0167–0173 First-order Models and Theories under the complete classical first-order profile
method: Fresh comparison of every exact frozen-English and Gujarati linguistic block, with independently worded reverse paraphrases for 40 representative substantive blocks. The review focuses on axiomatic theories and closure, model classes, definability, strict orders, groups, arithmetic, pure sets, mereology, expressed relations, first-order set constructions, cardinality conditions and all five adjacent disclosed source repairs.
